stem: A rain gutter is made from a long sheet of metal 24 centimeters wide by folding up a strip of width \(x\) centimeters along each long edge at a right angle, as shown. The cross section of the gutter is a rectangle with an area of 70 square centimeters. What are all the possible values of \(x\)?
solution: Folding up \(x\) on each edge leaves a base of \(24 - 2x\), so the area is \(x(24 - 2x) = 70\).
Both \(x = 5\) (base 14) and \(x = 7\) (base 10) give an area of 70, so both are possible.

explanation.C: Incorrect. These reverse the signs of the solutions; a width cannot be negative.
